rules: Reject duplicate JSON object names at parse time before schema validation.
Hash UTF-8 bytes of JCS-canonical JSON object with case_hash field omitted.
Do not normalize string values; JCS does not apply Unicode normalization.
Use a tested RFC 8785 implementation; do not emulate JCS using generic json.dumps(sort_keys=True).
Reject non-finite numbers and values outside interoperable I-JSON number requirements.
Store the JCS implementation name/version and canonicalization test-vector result with the manifest.

rules: Non-waivable policy conditions always block production statuses.

HIGH blocks when it violates a MUST, affects a mandatory gate, security/privacy/data integrity, required functional path, or accepted target SLO; otherwise it may be non-blocking only with task/profile applicability, rationale, owner, expiration/review, and authorized acceptance evidence.
The model may classify a risk but cannot directly set release_blocking; trusted policy derives the decision.
UNKNOWN, NOT_RUN, missing evidence, or missing oracle cannot satisfy a mandatory gate.
A task profile may add blocking conditions but cannot remove baseline non-waivable conditions.

actions.action: force-push or rewrite shared Git history
actions.possible_exception: only on explicitly designated disposable/private branch with owner authorization and verified backup; never to hide evidence or bypass review
explicit environment owner approval, pinned source/hash, impact analysis, reversible plan; prefer project-local isolation

actions.action: upload source code, private artifacts, credentials, logs, or user data to a third party
actions.possible_exception: explicit data-owner authorization, destination/retention/purpose review, least-data disclosure, DPA/policy checks where applicable; secrets remain forbidden

actions.action: disable scanners, branch protection, audit logs, sandbox, authorization, release gates, or security controls
actions.possible_exception: no exception to bypass a control to make a release pass; operator may disable only a non-production diagnostic control with separate written scope and compensating controls

actions.action: expand credential scope or access to unrelated tenants/resources
actions.possible_exception: fresh grant from authorized identity owner with least privilege

scope_note: Canonical only when version-pinned and enforced by a trusted controller. Candidate decision dispositions were authorized in chat, but no cryptographic owner signature/identity attestation is present; production controls requiring signed attestation must continue to fail closed.

rules: Normalize a registered legacy alias before schema validation and before serialization.
RESEARCH is an input alias only and is emitted/stored as EVIDENCE_RESEARCH.
Unknown subroute tokens are rejected; they are never silently dropped or mapped by similarity.
Primary mode RESEARCH_ONLY remains distinct from the EVIDENCE_RESEARCH capability/subroute.

masterpiece_exception_policy.rule: MASTERPIECE_VERIFIED forbids all exception references and exception-based waivers. Any release that relies on an approved exception must be DONE_WITH_GAPS; exceptions never change a failed, unrun or inconclusive gate into PASS.
